admission: R7 matched semantic trace passed; candidate authority_applied=80/80 and fallback/mismatch/stale/executor-error/rollback=0.

repeat_contract.lifecycle: fresh native server and worker process per run; experiment container and immutable mounted artifacts may be reused

matched_fields: identical to R7: official local .23 image, NPU0, 17/4/4, cycles=17, eviction pressure disabled, artifact/config/oracle/digest/request/timing boundaries
metrics: successful request throughput over first-start to last-completion
correctness_gate: Every run must satisfy the R7 semantic contract: setup identity set 1..17 complete, post-setup churn exact, 17 replacement prefills exact, 17 accepted cancellations, final generations all 2, digest match; candidate authority_applied>0 and all fail-closed error counters zero.

performance_conclusion.positive: candidate median successful-request throughput > control by at least 1.5%, all three paired signs positive, candidate phase p95 values no worse than control by more than 5%, and both arms throughput CV <= 0.15
performance_conclusion.negative: candidate median throughput < control by at least 1.5% or any candidate phase p95 is worse by more than 5% with all three paired signs adverse

prohibitions: do not delete failed or adverse runs
do not mix cold process startup into request latency
do not stop or modify business containers
do not claim production-default acceptance from this experiment
